scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed but playable with significant friction; 7 good with noticeable friction; 10 exceptional with negligible observed friction. Subjective quality of observed emulated mobile experience, not a completion grade or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, completable touch-assisted mission with useful contextual controls and atmospheric presentation; attention switching, exposure timing and dense small text add friction. Loss/win do not themselves determine the score.
reasons.controls: Large route/recover, FIRE and TURN controls worked with two contacts. Contextual assists reduced navigation/aim burden. Returning attention from rear threats to boss was cumbersome. Analog movement, fine FIRE drag, AIM, DASH and JUMP were not exercised; this is not a full control-scheme assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Recover/disable/return progression was clear and ammo/exposure management rewarded learning between runs. Rear attacks versus boss focus created pressure, sometimes frustrating. No assessment of extended replay enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber visual language, rain-soaked industrial setting, distinct title and terminal panels. Software-rendered screenshots cannot establish hardware animation/performance quality or audio quality.
reasons.usability: Clear fresh-start option, contextual objective travel and paused map helped. TOOLS adds a menu step for reload/swap; helper capture closes tray, so capture lifecycle is not charged as a game defect.
reasons.readability: Large objectives, button labels, health/ammo and numbered coil states were useful. Compact stats, handbook text and secondary labels are small at 844x390; handbook lower paragraphs were clipped by scroll area until scrolling (not exercised).

limitations: Synthetic native-touch Chromium at landscape 844x390; software-WebGL fallback explicitly reported.

Captures pause and clear contacts; frequent inspection breaks continuity, affords planning, and prevents certification of continuous enjoyment or live difficulty. Some resume/capture time can allow damage.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance, thermal/battery behavior and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
No source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, internal state or target metadata inspected. User-provided freeze hash was not verified against source.
